metadata.author: quant-os
metadata.rationale: Regression labels for two-stage meta-labeling Stage 1 (Direction Compass). Uses apply_friction_deadband() piecewise function: sub-friction returns are zeroed rather than having friction subtracted, preventing phantom inverted signals on tiny moves. Cent-account conservative defaults: slippage_pips=1.0 (not 0.5). Friction dead-band ≈ 0.05 bps for gold at 2600 — near-zero but critical for precision on micro-moves.
metadata.dead_band_rule: |return| <= friction -> 0 (neutral); return > friction -> return - friction (long signal); return < -friction -> return + friction (short signal)
metadata.evolution: Replaces simple friction subtraction with dead-band squashing per Architect Correction 1. Zeroes sub-friction returns rather than creating phantom inverted signals.
